author: Kevin Kelly
description: Community tools for first-time autoroles, sticky roles, welcome and goodbye embeds, solo voice disconnection, and member seen/presence statistics.
short: Roles, greetings, solo voice handling, and member statistics.
install_msg: Load with [p]load communityplus, then use [p]com help and [p]com diag. Solo voice disconnection starts enabled with a 900-second timeout; use [p]com vcsolo disable to turn it off while configuring the cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server settings, channel and role IDs, and welcome/goodbye templates. Per member, keyed by server and user IDs, it stores a first-seen flag, sticky role IDs, event timestamps and channel IDs, presence and platform statuses, last-online/offline times, message/voice/activity/status counters, and game names with launch counts. Ordinary message contents are not stored. The seenlistcsv command exports a summary for current members, and sticky purge clears only saved roles. Red user-data export and deletion hooks return or remove all stored member records across servers.
